# ISO 9001 Malaysia (isoconsultantmalaysia.com) — full text

Last updated: 2026-09-18

## Who we are
ISO 9001 Malaysia is the ISO consulting service of AA Alive Sdn Bhd (SSM 1204108-D), a Malaysian company founded in 2016 by Evin Lim, who is its Managing Director. We help organisations implement an ISO 9001:2015 quality management system (QMS) and prepare for certification. Certification itself is carried out by an accredited certification body (CB) after its own audit; we do not issue certificates.

- Legal name: AA Alive Sdn Bhd
- SSM registration: 1204108-D
- Consulting since: 2016
- Address: Lot 1, Jalan Perusahaan 4, Pusat Industri Amari, Kawasan Industri Batu Caves, 68100 Batu Caves, Selangor, Malaysia
- Website: https://isoconsultantmalaysia.com (English)

## Services
- ISO 9001 QMS consulting
- Gap analysis of current practices against ISO 9001:2015
- QMS documentation: quality policy, quality manual, procedures, work instructions, forms and records
- Staff training: quality awareness, role-specific and internal auditor training
- Implementation support, internal audit and management review facilitation
- Help selecting an accredited certification body, and preparation and support for its Stage 1 (documentation review) and Stage 2 (implementation) audits
- ISO 14001 (environmental) and ISO 45001 (occupational health and safety) consulting, including integrated management systems
- We build QMSs to ISO 9001:2015 and prepare them for the ISO 9001:2026 transition

## Consultancy packages
SME Package — from RM 13,000 — small businesses with 5–30 employees:
- Complete gap analysis assessment
- Full QMS documentation (quality manual, SOPs, forms)
- 2 on-site consultation visits
- Staff quality awareness training
- Internal audit support
- Certification audit preparation
- Audit day support
- 3 months post-certification guidance

Professional Package — RM 22,000 — medium businesses with 30–100 employees:
- Everything in the SME Package, plus advanced process mapping and optimization
- 4 on-site consultation visits
- Departmental-level training workshops
- Risk assessment and mitigation planning
- KPI framework development
- Management review facilitation
- 6 months post-certification support
- Surveillance audit preparation (year 1)

Enterprise Package — custom quotation — large organisations with 100+ employees or multiple sites:
- Everything in the Professional Package, plus multi-site coordination
- Executive leadership workshops
- Integrated management system (ISO 14001, ISO 45001)
- Supplier quality management setup
- 12 months ongoing support

Certification body audit fees are not included in these packages. They are quoted separately by the certification body and typically range from RM 3,000 to RM 8,000 for the initial certification audit, depending on organization size. Surveillance and recertification audit fees are also quoted by the certification body.

Payment terms: milestone-based, for example 50% upon commencement and 50% upon audit preparation.

## First consultation
The first consultation is free and without obligation, by WhatsApp, phone or video. After it we send a written proposal covering scope and investment. Paid work, including the gap analysis, starts only after the client accepts that proposal.

## How a project runs
1. Free initial consultation
2. Gap analysis against ISO 9001:2015
3. QMS documentation
4. Implementation and staff training
5. Internal audit and management review
6. Certification body audit (Stage 1 and Stage 2), carried out by the accredited certification body

Timeline: there is no fixed duration. It depends on the organisation's readiness, size and scope, how quickly documentation is reviewed, and the audit dates set by the certification body. We agree the project timeline with each client after the gap analysis.

## About ISO 9001 certification
- ISO 9001:2015 has 10 clauses; clauses 4–10 contain the requirements (context, leadership, planning, support, operation, performance evaluation, improvement)
- There are no prerequisites: any organisation of any size or industry can pursue certification
- A certificate is valid for 3 years, with surveillance audits in years 1 and 2 and a recertification audit in year 3
- Stage 1 is a documentation review (typically about 1 day for SMEs); Stage 2 is an on-site audit (typically 1–3 days depending on size)
- For minor non-conformities, the certification body typically allows 90 days to address them
- ISO 9001 is often requested by larger buyers and in tenders; requirements vary by buyer and tender
- Certification bodies operating in Malaysia include SIRIM QAS International, BSI, TUV SUD, TUV Rheinland, SGS, Bureau Veritas, DNV and Lloyd's Register
